request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful prehistoric lost-world storybook, playful and never scary. Everything is made of chunky pale cream bone, pale cream rawhide and dark basalt stone, lashed with charcoal grey cord, with knotted lashings, small cream teeth and chipped flint edges as details; bone and rawhide are shaded with cool grey, stone with darker blue-grey, never brown.
layers.negative: metal, iron, steel, armour plates, sword, wheels, wood, timber, planks, logs, straw, bricks, lava, fire, flames, orange glow, green skin, green scales, lime green, teal, purple, realistic reptile, scary, blood, gore, brown fur, brown hide, brown leather, tan, leopard spots, bronze, copper, rust, dark brown shading, red-brown, maroon

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the subject. No other red or red-brown anywhere: every other material, and its shading, uses colours that are clearly not red or red-brown.

Subject: Spitter, a chunky cute small upright spitting dinosaur with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a short sturdy body on two legs, the head and frill filling the whole width of the image: a wide round neck frill spread open like a fan all round the head, the frill plain flat bright red with a thin cream rim, dusty blue skin shaded darker navy blue with a pale cream belly, two small cream crests on top of the head, big round eyes, puffed cheeks and a pursed mouth spitting one small pale cream blob forward, small clawed arms, a plain bright red cloth poncho over the chest, belly and back down to the knees, a short tail, cream claws on the feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a frilled spitter, not an archer.

Its teeth, horns and claws are its only weapons; it holds nothing, carries no rider and no weapon, and wears no boots, belts or armour. The skin is a clear cornflower blue shaded navy blue: clearly blue, never grey. Every cord is charcoal grey, never brown.
layers.negative: bow, quiver, arrows, green spit, slime, umbrella, wings, rider, sword, axe, weapon, boots, belt, brown straps, brown bands, grey skin, slate skin
